title: Roadmap and WBS should be separated in AI-driven planning
observation: A single planning document made it hard to show both milestone intent and day-to-day execution state; separating roadmap from WBS produced a clearer structure for both humans and AI.
impact: The roadmap can explain sequencing and milestone purpose, while the WBS can stay focused on task status, completion checks, and holds without becoming a narrative document.
candidate_rule: When planning multi-step AI-driven implementation, keep roadmap and WBS as separate markdown documents and let ExecPlans sit below them.
evidence: mvp-implementation-roadmap.md could focus on milestone intent and task slicing
mvp-wbs.md could focus on status, completion criteria, and hold notes without restating roadmap rationale
